chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan ibn Yahya from Isḥaq ibn 'Ammar said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the visitation of the House (Kaaba) being delayed until the third day. He said: 'Hastening it is more beloved to me, and there is no harm in it if one delays it.'

key_terms.لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ: There is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the Tawaf of the Kaaba until the third day of Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the flexibility in the timing of the Tawaf for the Mut'ah Hajj, affirming that while hastening the circumambulation is preferred (*ahabb*), delaying it to the third day incurs no religious penalty (*laysa bi-ba's*). This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of ease (*rukhas*) in ritual acts, balancing the virtue of promptness with the permissibility of delay due to necessity or convenience.
